# H.V.A (Hive Vault Arc)

## Identity

- Company: Hive Vault Arc (H.V.A)
- Positioning: Hive Vault Arc is an AI-driven business transformation partner that designs, builds, and operates intelligent systems that run core business operations.
- Supporting line: We redesign and automate how businesses operate through consulting, AI agents, CRM, custom software, mobile apps, and SaaS systems.
- Base: Tangier, Morocco
- Languages: English, French, Arabic, Spanish

## What We Sell

- Category: AI Business Operating Systems
- Outcome sold: operational control, faster execution, and measurable business performance
- Industry examples:
  - Real Estate Operating System
  - Clinic Operating System
  - Construction Operations System

## Capabilities

- Business and IT consulting for operational redesign
- AI agent systems (WhatsApp, web, internal ops)
- CRM engineering and migration
- Workflow automation and process orchestration
- Custom software and SaaS development
- Mobile app engineering (Android/iOS)
- Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, reliability, and security

## Proven Deployments

### 1) Multilingual WhatsApp AI Agent (Real Estate)

- Live in production since October 2025
- First response latency: <18 seconds
- Manual triage reduction: 85%
- Qualified meetings increase: +43%

### 2) Zoho-Grade CRM Operating System (Real Estate)

- Live in production since May 2025
- Pipeline visibility: 100%
- Manual data-entry time: -40%
- Tracked pipeline volume: $2.4M monthly

### 3) Executive Analytics Control Tower (Healthcare)

- Live in production since January 2026
- Reporting cycle time: -72%
- KPI accuracy: 99.3%
- Executive decision latency on anomalies: -58%

## Technical Depth

- Event-driven AI orchestration
- Conversational memory and context layers
- Domain-driven CRM architecture
- Role-based access and audit logging
- ETL and semantic KPI layers
- CI/CD with controlled releases
- Observability, monitoring, and security hardening

## Commercial Model

- Pricing is private and discussed after discovery calls.
- Scope and commercial structure are tailored to business context, system complexity, and integration depth.
